title: Wonderful tour- personal and warm
text: Isabel is an absolute gem of a guide. Your tour is a conversation, not a lecture—adapted to your interests. She is also welcoming of all people and proud of her city’s multicultural heritage, inclusive of the Christian, Jewish, and Muslim traditions and contributions. Very highest recommendation!
author: Julia F

title: Superior tour guide!
text: Isabel is a wealth of knowledge and an extremely professional guide with a fantastic personality. Her communication ahead of time was on point to ensure we puchased the correct tickets for both the palace and cathedral as soon as they were made available. Highly recommend!
author: tthomas42

title: Our tour guide Isabel was...
text: Our tour guide Isabel was very thorough in explaining the history of the cathedral and palace.  She took great care of us through out our time together and was an excellent guide!
author: Dorothy_M

title: Wonderful Tour and Guide
text: Isabel was a wonderful tour guide.  She did not rush and hit all the great stories of the Royal Palace and Cathedral.   She even was able to skip the line with us.   Get your tickets early.
author: DonM16737

title: Great tour!
text: Isabel was a wonderful tour guide for the Royal Palace and Cathedral.  She did not rush and gave wonderful information.  We enjoyed our tour very much!!
author: Donald_M

title: Unparalleled!
text: Ms. Rico was a delightful companion for the morning and has a wonderful lighthearted sense of humor.  She was extremely knowledgeable and able to answer all of our random questions (e.g. Why is there a crocodile hanging from the ceiling?  Why does that dude have bats on his cape?).  I cannot imagine anyone doing a better job and would hire her again and again.  Highly recommended!
author: The_Atomic

title: Wonderful day!
text:
I highly recommend Isabel for your tours in Seville. 
We spent the afternoon touring the Cathedral and Alcazar and she is very knowledgeable, friendly and eager to answer all of our questions.  
We couldn’t have asked for a more informed guide.  She was also very helpful with the pace of our tour as my husband is a senior. 
Thank you Isabel for such a lovely day!
author: rosemaryv441

title: Fabulous tour!
text:
We really enjoyed our tour with Isabel. She was patient, cheerful, very knowledgeable and always had excellent answers to all  of our questions.
She also sent us lots of suggestions for places to see whilst in Seville. We loved it! 😊
author: 25NIC

title: Great tour with an experienced guide
text: Our group of four had a wonderful time with Isabel and on her tour of the Alcazar and the Seville Cathedral.  Isabel's comments were insightful and clear, and it was a much better experience than on group tours (which we had taken before of these same sites).  Because my sister and her husband were in Seville for the first time, we wanted them to have a special experience, and Isabel's tour was just that.  We toured all the Alcazar and the Cathedral, and I saw things I hadn't seen before, despite having been to these sites four times previously.  Isabel is highly recommended.
author: MARKL943
